jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data Governance
jobs.description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description

The Director, Enterprise Data Governance is accountable for defining and governing the enterprise data QuadReal relies on, anchored in DAMA-DMBOK, covering data definitions, ownership, quality, and observability. This makes QuadReal's data reliable enough to be governed, measured, and controlled, reducing the risk that decisions, reporting, and controls rest on data that can't be trusted. The role reports to the VP, Risk & Integrated Assurance and turns the VP's enterprise-wide mandate into one accountable operating model focused on risk mitigation through data governance lens.

Success is measured by the risk it mitigates: data issues caught before they become decisions made on incorrect information, ownership gaps closed before they become accountability gaps. Holding up under audit is one key aspect of that risk mitigation but not the goal in itself.

The Director also supports the VP's overall view of QuadReal's risk and control environment and represents Data Governance in Risk & Integrated Assurance reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Governance
Define QuadReal’s enterprise data definitions, classifications, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs), anchored in DAMA-DMBOK.
Own the data ownership and accountability model: name Data Owners, Stewards, and Custodians, and hold them accountable through a defined sign-off cadence.
Deliver the enterprise business glossary under a tiered governance model, and maintain metadata management, lineage standards, and dbt metadata synchronization across the platform.
Set data quality thresholds and Trusted Layer certification criteria, and hold data observability (freshness, pipeline health, trust scores) to the same standard as financial controls.
Align controls as gates across the data delivery lifecycle (ingestion, definition, build, use, and govern), so a control fires wherever data advances and nothing reaches a certified output without passing.
Build data governance capability across the business through training and playbooks, rather than keeping expertise centralized.
Integration and Decision Authority
Act as the link between Business Controls and Data Governance called for in the integrated operating model: define control standards and evidence expectations alongside data definitions, and build controls into new systems and initiatives from the start.
Where control standards and data definitions conflict, collaborate with relevant stakeholders including, ED&A, Business Owners and Business Controls to resolve these inconsistencies. Work with ED&A / Technology and the Data Platform team so controls and governance are proactively built into the toolchain (Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Airflow, Power BI, Purview, Entra ID, Quadrant) by design.
Represent Data Governance in Risk & Integrated Assurance meetings and support Audit Committee reporting.
Team Leadership
Lead and develop direct report(s) and set clear deliverables and cadence for them..
Build team capability in data analytics, AI literacy, and integrated systems controls as the role grows, and build bench strength to move the environment from project to sustained run-state without single points of failure.
Build a “one team” culture between Business Controls and Data Governance that removes duplicate work and closes the gaps that used to sit between the two groups.

What Success Looks Like

Controls operating as gates, each with a named owner and re-performable evidence.
Audit outcomes: clean walkthroughs, deficiencies remediated, and SOC scope defensible.
Glossary and standards adopted, so certified numbers are built on agreed definitions.
Governance measured by delivery: trusted, in-use data products standing behind reported figures.
Direct reports delivering to plan, with growing capability and bench strength.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Risk Management, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related discipline; Master is an asset.
8+ years of progressive experience across data governance, risk management, or audit, including at least 2 years leading people, and demonstrable end-to-end delivery of a control or governance environment.
Working knowledge of ICFR, SOC 1 / ISAE 3402, COSO 2013, ITGCs, and DAMA-DMBOK; CPA, CIA, CISA, or CDMP an asset. Familiarity with DCAM / CDMC and data contracts an asset.
Hands-on experience with data cataloguing and governance tooling (Microsoft Purview equivalents such as Collibra an asset) and with controls testing in an ICFR or SOX environment.
Working knowledge of a modern data-platform stack (Microsoft Fabric / lakehouse, dbt, Airflow, Power BI, Entra ID), enough to specify and validate controls.
Working knowledge of Yardi strongly preferred.
Investment and portfolio management literacy or business acumen
Proven ability to build controls that produce retained, re-testable evidence.
Ability to work across Finance, IT, and Data & Analytics, and turn technical and operational complexity into clear governance and control frameworks.
Comfortable preparing materials for senior leadership and the Audit Committee.
Comfortable building or growing an early-stage function.
Experience within real estate, asset management, pension, or investment management environments strongly preferred.

This is a newly created role within our organization.

The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $155,000 – $175,000.

Based on the position, QuadReal offers a competitive total rewards package in addition to the base pay, which may include a performance-based incentive plan, comprehensive health & dental benefits, pension plan, and paid time off.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

IPEX est l’un des principaux fournisseurs nord-américains de systèmes de canalisations en plastique de pointe. Notre mission est de façonner un avenir meilleur en reliant les collectivités à l’eau et à l’énergie
.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un Directeur du programme PRE
pour se joindre à notre équipe. Ce poste est basé à Oakville (Ontario) ou Montréal (Québec)
et relève du vice-président, TI.

Ne manquez pas l’occasion de vous joindre à une équipe diversifiée de professionnels centrés sur l’humain, de leaders d’opinion, d’esprits novateurs et d’entrepreneurs qui remettent en question le statu quo.

Sommaire du poste

À titre de Directeur du programme PRE, vous serez responsable de la gouvernance et de l’exécution de bout en bout de l’écosystème ERP d’IPEX, avec une responsabilité particulière à l’égard du programme de transformation SAP S/4HANA. En étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’affaires et des technologies de l’information, vous assurerez la réalisation d’une initiative stratégique d’envergure visant à soutenir les objectifs opérationnels et la croissance à long terme de l’entreprise.

Cette fonction représente une occasion unique de jouer un rôle de premier plan au sein de l’un des plus importants programmes de transformation technologique et organisationnelle d’IPEX. À la croisée des technologies, des opérations et de la gouvernance d’entreprise, vous veillerez à l’alignement des priorités d’affaires avec l’exécution du programme à l’échelle de notre réseau manufacturier nord-américain. La personne retenue possède une expertise approfondie de SAP, une solide expérience en gouvernance de programmes et la capacité de piloter des initiatives complexes dans un environnement en constante évolution.

Responsabilités principales

Assurer le succès du programme grâce à un partenariat tripartite structuré entre les TI, les unités d’affaires et l’intégrateur de systèmes, en définissant clairement les rôles, les droits décisionnels et les responsabilités à tous les niveaux de gouvernance.
Être responsable de l’atteinte des résultats d’affaires ciblés, de la réalisation des bénéfices attendus ainsi que de la stabilisation opérationnelle suivant les principales phases de déploiement et les mises en production.
Établir et appliquer les cadres de gouvernance du programme, incluant les points de contrôle, les comités de pilotage, les registres de risques et les mécanismes d’escalade.
Gérer les calendriers intégrés du programme, les plans de ressources, les risques, les interdépendances et les budgets excédant 10 M$.
Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires composées de plus de 50 employés internes et consultants externes.
Assurer la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction et au conseil d’administration, notamment les tableaux de bord de performance, les prévisions financières et le suivi des jalons stratégiques.
Établir et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les intégrateurs de systèmes et les fournisseurs stratégiques, tout en assurant le respect rigoureux des engagements contractuels, des échéanciers et des normes de performance.
Piloter les stratégies de préparation organisationnelle, de gestion du changement et de communication en partenariat avec les équipes responsables de la transformation et des affaires chez IPEX.
Promouvoir la standardisation des processus, la gouvernance des données et la gestion des données maîtres à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

Qualifications Et Expérience

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience progressive en leadership dans le domaine des technologies de l’information, dont un minimum de 5 ans dans des fonctions de direction associées à la livraison de programmes ERP.
Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, en informatique, en génie ou en administration des affaires (obligatoire); MBA fortement souhaité.
Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite d’implantations complètes de SAP S/4HANA (greenfield ou brownfield) au sein d’environnements manufacturiers ou industriels.
Expérience de gestion de programmes ERP pluriannuels comportant des budgets supérieurs à 10 M$ et des équipes de plus de 50 personnes réparties sur plusieurs sites et plusieurs pays.
Excellente connaissance des modules SAP S/4HANA; familiarité avec SAP BTP ainsi qu’avec la gestion des versions et des environnements SAP.
Excellentes compétences en communication exécutive et capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes auprès de la haute direction et du conseil d’administration.
Solides aptitudes en négociation, en gestion de fournisseurs et en influence au sein d’environnements matriciels.
Capacité démontrée à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté, à prendre des décisions sous pression et à instaurer un climat de confiance auprès d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
Aptitude à diriger des transformations organisationnelles d’envergure en favorisant l’adhésion, l’alignement et l’engagement des parties prenantes.
Expérience démontrée dans l’atteinte des résultats convenus, la réalisation des bénéfices escomptés, l’amélioration de la performance opérationnelle et l’atteinte des objectifs du programme.
Capacité à identifier, évaluer et atténuer les risques de façon proactive tout en assurant l’efficacité des mécanismes de gouvernance et d’escalade.
Engagement envers l’innovation, l’optimisation des processus et l’excellence opérationnelle afin de maximiser la valeur d’affaires et les capacités de la plateforme ERP.

Mobilité

Une mobilité est requise selon les besoins de l'entreprise et les étapes clés du programme, incluant des visites dans les installations d'IPEX, sur les sites de projets et auprès de partenaires, au besoin.

IPEX s’engage à offrir des mesures d’adaptation aux personnes en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement. Sur demande, nous collaborerons avec les candidats qualifiés afin de fournir des accommodements adaptés à leurs besoins en matière d’accessibilité. Les demandes d’adaptation sont les bienvenues à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection. Pour obtenir une mesure d’adaptation, veuillez communiquer avec les Ressources humaines à l’adresse askhr@ipexna.com.

IPEX is one of the North American leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy
.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Director, ERP Program Delivery
. This role is based in our Oakville, ON or Montreal, QC
location and reports to the VP, IT
.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As Director, ERP Program Delivery,
you will be accountable for the end-to-end governance and delivery of IPEX's ERP landscape, with a primary focus on our SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working in partnership with business and IT leaders, you will help drive the successful execution of a complex, multi-year transformation initiative that supports IPEX's strategic and operational objectives.

This is an opportunity to play a key leadership role in one of IPEX's most significant technology and business transformation programs. You will operate at the intersection of technology, operations, and executive leadership, helping to align business priorities with program delivery while supporting our North American manufacturing footprint. The ideal candidate brings deep SAP expertise, strong program governance capabilities, and the ability to lead large-scale initiatives in a complex and evolving environment.

Principal Responsibilities

Drive program success through a deliberate three-way partnership among IT, the Business, and the System Integrator, with clearly defined roles, decision rights, and accountability across all levels of governance.
Accountable for delivery of targeted business outcomes, value realization, and operational stabilization following key deployment milestones and go-live events.
Establish and enforce program governance frameworks including stage gates, steering cadences, risk registers, and escalation protocols.
Manage integrated program schedules, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and budgets exceeding $10M.
Lead cross-functional teams of 50+ internal staff and external consultants.
Drive executive and board-level reporting including program health dashboards, financial forecasts, and milestone tracking.
Build and sustain high-trust partnerships with system integrators and third-party vendors while maintaining rigorous accountability to contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and performance standards.
Lead organizational readiness, change management, and communications strategies in partnership with the IPEX Change Management and Business Leads.
Champion process standardization, data governance, and master data management across the enterprise.

Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of progressive IT leadership and a minimum of 5 years in senior ERP program delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or Business (required); MBA strongly preferred.
Proven track record leading full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations (greenfield or brownfield) in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Experience managing multi-year ERP programs with budgets exceeding $10M and teams of 50+ across multi-plant, multi-country environments.
Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules; familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP release and environment management.
Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business language for C-suite and board audiences.
Strong negotiation, vendor management, and influencing skills in a matrixed organization.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive decisions under pressure, and build trust across cross-functional teams.
Ability to effectively lead large-scale organizational change, driving alignment, adoption, and commitment across diverse stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated accountability for delivering agreed outcomes, benefits realization, operational improvements, and program objectives.
Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks while ensuring effective governance and escalation processes.
Champions innovation, process optimization, and operational excellence to maximize business value and ERP platform capabilities.

Travel:
Travel required based on business needs and key program milestones, including visits to IPEX locations, project sites, and partner locations as necessary.

Director of Silicon Engineering, AI-Native Chip Design

About Cognichip

At Cognichip, we are building AI-native tools that transform how semiconductor engineers create, verify, and optimize chips.

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Build a “one team” culture between Business Controls and Data Governance that removes duplicate work and closes the gaps that used to sit between the two groups.

Controls operating as gates, each with a named owner and re-performable evidence.

Comfortable building or growing an early-stage function.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
